Details

The Vera Luxe Co-ord Set is designed for fluid movement, versatile styling, and everyday luxury with intention. Crafted from organic cotton Tencel twill fabric, this purple co-ord set offers a soft, breathable feel with a refined drape that moves effortlessly with you. The faltered drop-shoulder top features a V neckline with eyelets threaded with braided drawstring straps finished with metallic trims for a subtle statement. Flared sleeves with tie belts add softness and structure, allowing you to adjust the look while maintaining comfort and elegance. Designed to be size-versatile from XS to M, the top adapts naturally to different body shapes. The pants are thoughtfully constructed with a gathered waistband, side ties on both ends, and two metal zippers that allow you to adjust the length—wear them short, calf-length, or full-length depending on your mood or occasion. Elasticated hems complete the silhouette, ensuring ease and flexibility with every wear. Finished with a detachable waist belt for an added styling option, the Vera Luxe Co-ord Set is an expression of modern adaptability—designed to shift, evolve, and style itself around you. Because true luxury lies in comfort, versatility, and thoughtful design.
